findings.title: Findings converge on the stream's use of the coordinator's refresh machinery as its control signals
findings.why_it_matters: Six findings trace to the debouncer/listener/last_update_success semantics; patches would interact.
findings.recommended: A: Re-evaluate
findings.chosen: A: Re-evaluate

findings.title: The listing-vs-held merge is undefined, and entity_revision can't order the non-entity fields a listing carries
findings.why_it_matters: Marks order entity values only; status and other fields have no merge rule.
findings.recommended: A: Per-field merge
findings.chosen: A: Per-field merge

findings.title: The on_connected resync path is unspecified
findings.why_it_matters: Each obvious resync path breaks subscribe-before-fetch.
findings.recommended: A: Locked async_refresh(), then check that last_success advanced
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: D3's start after a good poll infers reachability from listener calls
findings.why_it_matters: Listeners fire on tolerated failures and pushes.
findings.recommended: B: Keep the coordinator listener, gated on last_success advancing
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: Awaiting async_request_refresh() in on_message stalls the stream reader
findings.why_it_matters: The debouncer runs the first request inline.
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: A push whose target the held listing lacks is ignored
findings.why_it_matters: A new instance's first set() can be lost for 30 s.
findings.recommended: A: Unknown same-boot target requests a refresh, with exclusions
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: Nothing records why a push didn't land
findings.why_it_matters: The poll hides stream failures; no diagnostics.
findings.recommended: B: Debug log for each ignored push, with its reason
findings.chosen: B: Debug log for each ignored push, with its reason
findings.choice_reason: B + file an issue (filed as hass-hassette#81)

findings.title: An apply exception ends the stream every cycle; log suppression resets on connect
findings.why_it_matters: Flapping stream with repeated logs.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: D2's debounced refresh can be dropped while a slow poll holds the lock
findings.why_it_matters: Status change waits up to 30 s.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: D1 A fans every push out to every entity and every platform's add_new walk
findings.why_it_matters: Audience assumption: large chatty installs.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The lossless-or-close assumption is stated more strongly than the server guarantees
findings.why_it_matters: A push that fails to build is lost until the next poll.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: D2's status_revision compare is seeded from the clock and ignores boot_id
findings.why_it_matters: Audience assumption: clocks stepping backwards.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: Findings converge on the stream's failure reporting (log_failure_once, logged_failures, the info level)
findings.why_it_matters: Info-level, type-keyed, connect-re-armed failure logging hides a stream that never works and repeats every 30 s for one that connects then fails.
findings.recommended: A: Re-evaluate the stream's failure reporting before addressing Findings 3 and 4 individually.
findings.chosen: A: Re-evaluate the stream's failure reporting before addressing Findings 3 and 4 individually.
findings.choice_reason: Adopted the prior-art-backed rule: working = resync succeeded; warning once before it ever works; info for drops after; re-arm on resync success; unreadable message warns once per setup.

findings.title: The per-instance mark treats every held entity as newer than the listing when only one was pushed
findings.why_it_matters: After a reload race, un-pushed entities keep pre-reload values and declarations for up to 30 s.
findings.recommended: A: Mark per pushed entity.
findings.chosen: A: Mark per pushed entity.

findings.title: A stream that never works, or can't parse what hassette sends, is logged only at info
findings.why_it_matters: Users behind proxies without WebSocket support never learn live updates are off.
findings.recommended: A: Log at warning, once, a failure of a stream that hasn't worked since setup, and keep info for drops of a stream that worked.
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: Clearing logged failures on every connect makes a connect-then-fail stream log twice every 30 s
findings.why_it_matters: The once-per-kind rule repeats every poll for a stream that connects and then fails.
findings.recommended: A: Clear logged_failures, and log Connected, only once the stream has proven it works.
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: The entities is None branch in merge_instance guards a state GET /api/apps never sends
findings.why_it_matters: Defensive branch for a state the wire contract rules out, handled inconsistently.
findings.recommended: A: Delete the None branch, its test and the Build note's reason, and amend D5's entities None clause.
findings.chosen: A: Delete the None branch, its test and the Build note's reason, and amend D5's entities None clause.
findings.choice_reason: Listed as a clear-cut pick before the walkthrough; the user didn't object.

findings.title: eager_start=False is justified by a race that only the test fake can produce
findings.why_it_matters: The comment describes a production hazard that doesn't exist; the fake departs from the real contract.
findings.recommended: B: Make FakeStream.listen yield once before awaiting on_connected, then drop eager_start=False.
findings.chosen: B: Make FakeStream.listen yield once before awaiting on_connected, then drop eager_start=False.
findings.choice_reason: Listed as a clear-cut pick before the walkthrough; the user didn't object.

findings.title: No test pins the message classes against the real client, the non-blocking on_message, or two good polls in one clock tick
findings.why_it_matters: Three properties the design relies on could regress with the suite green.
findings.chosen: Add three tests: message_classes(MESSAGE_TYPES) maps the three tags; on_message returns before a held refresh finishes; the stream runs after a resync in the same frozen clock tick.

findings.title: A stream that connects and then drops costs an extra listing on every poll
findings.why_it_matters: Bounded extra load on a struggling hassette.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: Every pushed value recomputes every entity, with no bound on how often apps push
findings.why_it_matters: Bursts recompute every entity per push.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: Refresh triggers from the stream are bounded only by HA's 1 s debouncer
findings.why_it_matters: The rate bound lives in HA's helper, untested here.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation
